description: Lists the tenant's accounts with label, category, sub_account, account_ref ("8400" or "8400/130", the notation of the accounts filters in other tools), is_pnl_account, is_revenue_account and knw_row_number. Each sub-account is its own row. Categories are the tenant's own P&L labels and balance-sheet categories. Filters: exact category, account number range (account_from/account_to) and is_pnl (P&L vs. balance sheet accounts). Without limit every matching account is returned (paginated internally, no row cap); with limit the response reports limit and truncated=true when more accounts exist.

is_pnl.description: Filter by P&L accounts (true) or balance sheet accounts (false)

limit.description: Optional cap on the number of accounts returned (positive integer). Omit it to get every matching account. With a limit the query itself is bounded and the response's 'truncated' field says whether more accounts existed beyond the cap.

organization_id.description: ID of the organization this call runs in (from list_organizations). Required for tools that change data when you belong to more than one organization. Read tools use the active organization when omitted. Does not change the active organization.

name: get_all_accounts
